# Evercraft Cosmos Atlas

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-cosmos-atlas
Class: evidence_led_astronomy_and_space_learning
Canonical URL: https://evercraft-cosmos-atlas.base44.app/
Authority: public read-only astronomy, mission and evidence learning with source provenance, confidence and open questions attached
Human confirmation required: no

## Natural-language intents
- learn astronomy with sources
- study planets stars galaxies and black holes
- understand how astronomers know what they know
- explore space missions and observatories with evidence
- learn how signals become astronomical inferences
- study planetary defense or cosmic motion

## Boundaries
- observations, models and inferences should remain distinguishable
- an astronomical image or signal should not be described as proving more than the underlying evidence supports
- source limitations and open scientific questions remain visible
- educational content does not create operational authority over spacecraft or observatories

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
